# apple_ping_webhook (Action)

Sends a test event to a webhook, to check that the receiver gets and verifies it. The webhook must be enabled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_ping_webhook" "builds" {
  config {
    webhook_id = apple_webhook.builds.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `webhook_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the webhook, e.g. `apple_webhook.example.id`.
